t: This is 54 Mount Street, a grade two star listed house in Mayfair, within the City of Westminster. Today it's the residence of the Brazilian ambassador. The embassy's main building is elsewhere, on Cockspur Street. The house was designed by Fairfax Blomfield Wade-Palmer, an English architect who lived from 1851 to 1919. He was also a noted textile designer, and his sister Louisa Anne Wade led the Royal School of Needlework.
